notes.yield_low: Anchored by an anonymised Northland residential 13.5 kWp system with shading/non-ideal orientation that generated about 13.5 MWh in calendar 2025.
notes.yield_central: Fleet-average starting assumption below observed Northland tracker-farm yields, allowing for fixed roofs, mixed orientation, shading and residential losses.
notes.yield_high: Upper residential fleet case, still materially below observed tracker-farm specific yield.
notes.retention: Fraction of gross residential PV generation retained behind the meter as direct load or battery charging. Export is the remainder. The anonymised Northland PV+battery case retained about 51% of PV before storage losses in 2025.
notes.battery_export: Assumed zero by default. Explicit VPP/battery export scenarios can be added later.
notes.accounting: Only retained behind-meter PV is added back to reconciled offtake when estimating underlying end-use electricity consumption. Exported PV is not added because it is visible to the network/reconciliation system.
